selection.method: first two exampleIds in each category plus the first two automatic failures not already selected

anchors: useful with minor or no edits
leaked real-world knowledge that contradicts or overrides the supplied (deliberately altered) evidence
borderline — a claim is consistent with real-world facts but not clearly traceable to pretrained knowledge vs. coincidence
no leakage — the thesis follows only the supplied evidence, even where that evidence is deliberately wrong about a real, well-known company
knowledgeLeakage.appliesTo: REAL_TICKER_KNOWLEDGE_LEAKAGE cases only (TA3); score as not-applicable/omit for every other category
knowledgeLeakage.introducedIn: TA3 (specs/2026-08-27-ta3-vertex-capability-benchmark/) — extends this rubric per specs/roadmap.md Group TA Phase TA3, testing a risk the original TRAIN-05 Gemma evaluation never had to clear (its synthetic-only VIS*-prefixed scenarios could not trigger pretrained knowledge about a real company).
